title: Grateful Dead Live at Manor Downs on 1982-07-31
source: fkac16: Exact "as is" untouched DAT transfers from Dick Latvala Transfered by Jamie Waddell on the **GEMS** Edit Station Weiss-Saracon for SRC and Pow-r3 Dither to 16 bit 44.1 kHz

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 summer show with a smoking Scarlet > Fire transition and solid recording from Dick Latvala’s DAT source
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its classic jams, especially the legendary Scarlet > Fire segue, tight second‑set flow and strong contributions from Phil, Bob and Jerry. Reviewers repeatedly note the clear, well‑balanced Latvala audience/DAT tape, calling it “quality sound” and “awesome”, making the show both musically and technically enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (10/11) give 4‑5 stars, highlighting standout jams and excellent recording quality; only one non‑informative low rating exists.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Latvala DAT transfer described as clear, balanced and “awesome”; no major dropouts or muffiness reported.

poor_songs: Truckin' (transition from UJB a bit off)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set packed with solid classics; second set ramps up with hot Scarlet > Fire opener, smooth Estimated‑Eyes flow and a strong closing suite through The Other One → Morning Dew → Sugar Magnolia.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Missing Jerry on Morning Dew noted emotionally, but his presence elsewhere still praised; overall solid guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as a “beast” firing bombs—exceptional bass throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals and rhythm guitar highlighted as great, especially in the second set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Uptempo drum bursts noted positively; overall tight rhythmic support.
